subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should agents be allowed to create Slack and Discord channels, and if so which default-off provider gate, least-privilege scopes, credential source, and shared-workspace safeguards must authorize the operation?
rationale: Channel creation mutates shared organizational structure using privileged credentials, and repository source cannot establish the intended product and security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve gated administration
options.body: Add account-specific, default-off channel-administration gates with least-privilege provider scopes, explicit credential rules, documentation, and live provider proof.

options.title: Limit support to Discord
options.body: Keep Discord's existing gated channel actions and decline native Slack workspace administration for now.

options.title: Keep provisioning external
options.body: Do not expose channel creation to agents and document direct provider APIs or external automation as the supported provisioning path.

recommendation.title: Approve gated administration
recommendation.body: Add account-specific, default-off channel-administration gates with least-privilege provider scopes, explicit credential rules, documentation, and live provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for the current CLI and Slack action boundaries and already reviewed the issue's design surface.
